svg.title: DeskOS: layered composition
svg.desc: DeskOS composition. Profiles sit at four layers with explicit precedence, bottom to top: foundation (DeskOS Core), organization (example-baseline), role (example-devops) and workstation. Three composition classes: set, a deterministic union where duplicates collapse (packages, groups, systemd units, GNOME locks); keyed, one definition per key where identical definitions deduplicate and different ones fail at any layer (repositories, binaries, Flatpak remotes and apps); scalar, where the highest layer wins and different values at one layer fail (GNOME settings). Example: Core sets session.idle.blankAfter to 10m and the organization GnomeProfile example-desktop sets 5m, so 5m wins; Core and organization packages are unioned. File order and profile order never set precedence. The result is the Plan, a typed IR where every value keeps its provenance: resource, layer, file and line.
